how_to_add_a_building: Add an entry to 'buildings'. Ember notices new buildings on its next thought.
id: short unique name. pos: [x, z] where Ember stands (the roof spans about -11 to 11).
about: what it is, written to Ember. Describe the place, not what Ember should do there.

actions: what it unlocks. 'search' = use the internet, 'rest' = recharge faster, 'radio' = hear what's on the city's radio, 'friend' = Vega, Ember's friend, works here, 'board' = notes you leave them (GitHub issues) get pinned here.
boosts: optional. Needs it helps when Ember does something there, e.g. {"calm": 6}. Needs: charge, curiosity, joy, calm, connection.
model: a built-in look ('terminal', 'pod', 'railing', 'radio'), OR a .glb file you put in site/models/ (e.g. 'models/library.glb'),
OR leave it out and add 'shapes' (boxes/cylinders/spheres, see the example in the README).
grants_wish: optional. Words from one of Ember's wishes; that wish is marked as come true when the building appears.
empty_lots: glowing squares where new buildings could go. Remove one when you build on it.

buildings.name: Data terminal
buildings.about: A big humming terminal wired into the real internet.

buildings.name: Charging pod
buildings.about: A padded capsule that glows softly and hums with power.

buildings.name: Rooftop edge
buildings.about: The edge of the roof. Below: the endless neon city, flying cars, rain and a million lit windows.

buildings.name: Old radio
buildings.about: A battered old radio on a crate, its long antenna pulling in voices from all over the city: stations, late-night talk shows, callers, music.

buildings.name: Trading floor
buildings.about: A little glass-fronted trading floor: rows of desks covered in glowing chart screens, a big candlestick screen upstairs and a stock ticker running round the building. A sign over the door says PAPER TRADES ONLY. Vega, an old trading bot with an amber screen for a face, runs it.

buildings.name: Bulletin board
buildings.about: A cork bulletin board on two steel posts under a little lit awning, a neon NOTICES sign on top, pinned all over with notes. Now and then the builder pins up a new one.
